atlases.scenes: 1. Happily holding a little bowl of fluffy white rice with chopsticks, eyes sparkling. 2. Carefully stirring a small cooking pot with a ladle, a tiny puff of steam. 3. Sitting with an open storybook on her lap and reading with interest. 4. Wearing small over-ear headphones, eyes closed, gently enjoying music. 5. Watering a tiny potted sprout with a small watering can. 6. Curled up inside a soft pale-blue blanket with only her face and hands peeking out, cozy and content.
atlases.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE NEW square transparent PNG sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six separate hand-drawn doodles for a diary UI.
Input image 1 is the character identity reference: preserve her long blue hair, blue eyes, white maid headband, tiny blue bows, navy-and-white frilled maid outfit, whale emblem apron, and blue whale-tail hair detail.
Input image 2 is the EXISTING doodle atlas and is only a style reference: closely match its cute chibi proportions, soft colored-pencil grain, blue pencil contours, warm blush, simple expressive face, and restrained navy/periwinkle/white palette with small muted accent colors. Do NOT repeat its six scenes.
Each of the six equal cells must contain a complete, distinct vignette with the SAME character. Keep every character, prop, tiny sparkle or accent wholly inside its cell. Center each vignette with at least 8 percent transparent padding on every side within its cell. The cell boundaries are invisible; do not draw grid lines. Small props only, no large scenery. True transparent background with retained alpha, not a checkerboard or white paper backdrop. Do not add text, labels, lettering, logos, panel borders or watermark. Keep the illustration handmade and delicate, not glossy or vector-flat.
Read the six scenes in row-major order (top left, top middle, top right, bottom left, bottom middle, bottom right).
Scenes for this new atlas:
1. Happily holding a little bowl of fluffy white rice with chopsticks, eyes sparkling. 2. Carefully stirring a small cooking pot with a ladle, a tiny puff of steam. 3. Sitting with an open storybook on her lap and reading with interest. 4. Wearing small over-ear headphones, eyes closed, gently enjoying music. 5. Watering a tiny potted sprout with a small watering can. 6. Curled up inside a soft pale-blue blanket with only her face and hands peeking out, cozy and content.

atlases.scenes: 1. Inspecting a small cute toy bug through a magnifying glass, focused and curious, not frightened. 2. Thinking hard while turning a colorful small puzzle cube. 3. Carefully building a tiny bridge from wooden toy blocks. 4. Neatly sorting a few colored note cards and papers, no readable writing. 5. Looking through a miniature telescope at a tiny drawn star above it. 6. Folding a little paper boat, proud of the neat fold.

atlases.scenes: 1. Holding a small pastel-blue umbrella beside two tiny raindrop doodles, cheerful. 2. Peeking through a small vintage camera, taking a photo. 3. Holding the string of a tiny whale-shaped kite, with the full kite and short string inside her cell. 4. Wearing a small cozy scarf over the SAME maid outfit, admiring one autumn leaf in her hand. 5. Celebrating a little success, raising a small golden star, delighted. 6. A softly smug but sweet expression, one hand on her hip and the other giving a small thumbs-up, slightly rosy cheeks.
